description: Reperes de crues 76 2025 Min Devpmt Durable is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département de la Seine Maritime. Flood markers are historical witnesses of past great floods. They reflect the memory of these important events, which can sometimes be biased by time or trauma, by indicating the maximum level reached by a flood event at a given point. Coverage: Département de la Seine Maritime. The portal shows the English title as "Floodfall 76 2025 Min Devpmt Sustainable" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département de la Seine Maritime. Its keywords include communes, reperes-de-crues, geospatial, crues. The listing shows 6 download or service links in KML, WEB PAGE, GEOJSON, CSV. The listing shows 2025-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
